Read also Military Operation in Ukraine: Chronicle of Events, October 22, 2025  "T-72B3M tank crews from the 60th Motorized Rifle Brigade of the 5th Guards Combined Arms Army of the Vostok Group of Forces carried out fire strikes on camouflaged enemy positions in the Dnipropetrovsk region. Having received the target coordinates, the tank crews took up firing positions and opened fire with 125mm high-explosive shells," the department reported.  They noted that drone operators adjusted fire and monitored target engagements in real time. This allowed the crews to engage targets with high precision and minimal ammunition consumption.
